# AppPage

A full-viewport page scaffold composed of six sub-components: `AppPage` (root), `AppPageHeader` (top bar), `AppPageMain` (fill area), `AppPageAside` (sidebar), `AppPageContent` (content area), and `AppPageFooter` (pinned footer). `AppPageFooter` can be placed as a direct child of `AppPage` to span the full width, or passed via `AppPageContent`'s `footer` prop to pin it inside the content column only.

```ts
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
  AppPageFooter,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

| Component        | Role                                                                |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `AppPage`        | Root — flex column, full-height container                           |
| `AppPageHeader`  | Fixed-height top bar — titles, breadcrumbs, actions                 |
| `AppPageMain`    | Flex row that fills the remaining height                            |
| `AppPageAside`   | Sidebar with independent vertical scroll                            |
| `AppPageContent` | Main panel with independent vertical scroll                         |
| `AppPageFooter`  | Pinned footer — full-width or content-column depending on placement |

## Basic Usage

The standard layout imports all five components and composes them directly. Both `AppPageAside` and `AppPageContent` scroll independently when their content exceeds the available height.

```tsx preview
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
  Typography,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const rows = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => `Row item ${i + 1}`);
  const navItems = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => `Nav item ${i + 1}`);

  return (
    <Box
      height={400}
      style={{
        border: `1px solid ${theme.basic300}`,
        borderRadius: 4,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
    >
      <AppPage data-qa="app-page">
        <AppPageHeader data-qa="app-header">
          <Flex alignY="center" gap={2} direction="column">
            <Typography
              variant="card-title"
              asLevel={4}
              color={theme.textDefault}
            >
              Meeting Finder
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.basic600}>
              Recommends optimal meeting times based on agent availability
            </Typography>
          </Flex>
        </AppPageHeader>

        <AppPageMain data-qa="app-main">
          <AppPageAside isBordered data-qa="app-aside">
            <Flex direction="column" gap={2}>
              {navItems.map((item) => (
                <Box
                  key={item}
                  paddingX={3}
                  paddingY={2}
                  backgroundColor={theme.primarySurface}
                  style={{ borderRadius: 4, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body" color={theme.primary600}>
                    {item}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </AppPageAside>

          <AppPageContent data-qa="app-content">
            <Flex direction="column" gap={3}>
              {rows.map((row) => (
                <Box
                  key={row}
                  paddingX={4}
                  paddingY={3}
                  backgroundColor={theme.basic100}
                  style={{ borderRadius: 4 }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body" color={theme.textDefault}>
                    {row}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </AppPageContent>
        </AppPageMain>
      </AppPage>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Without Aside

When `AppPageAside` is omitted, `AppPageContent` expands to fill the full width of `AppPageMain`.

```tsx preview
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageContent,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageContent,
  Typography,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const rows = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => `Content item ${i + 1}`);

  return (
    <Box
      height={360}
      style={{
        border: `1px solid ${theme.basic300}`,
        borderRadius: 4,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
    >
      <AppPage data-qa="app-page-no-aside">
        <AppPageHeader data-qa="app-header">
          <Flex alignY="center" alignX="space-between">
            <Typography
              variant="card-title"
              asLevel={4}
              color={theme.textDefault}
            >
              Agent Schedule
            </Typography>
            <Box
              paddingX={4}
              paddingY={2}
              backgroundColor={theme.primary600}
              style={{ borderRadius: 20, cursor: 'pointer' }}
            >
              <Typography variant="body-emphasis" color={theme.white}>
                Export
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </Flex>
        </AppPageHeader>

        <AppPageMain data-qa="app-main">
          <AppPageContent data-qa="app-content">
            <Flex direction="column" gap={3}>
              {rows.map((item) => (
                <Box
                  key={item}
                  paddingX={4}
                  paddingY={3}
                  backgroundColor={theme.basic100}
                  style={{ borderRadius: 4 }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body" color={theme.textDefault}>
                    {item}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </AppPageContent>
        </AppPageMain>
      </AppPage>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Custom Aside Width

Use the `width` prop on `AppPageAside` to override the default 240 px sidebar width. Accepts any CSS width value or a pixel number.

- Top: `width={300}` — wider sidebar for complex filter forms
- Bottom: `width="30%"` — proportional sidebar using a percentage

```tsx preview
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
  Typography,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

function PageShell({
  asideWidth,
  label,
}: {
  asideWidth: number | string;
  label: string;
}) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  return (
    <Box
      height={220}
      style={{
        border: `1px solid ${theme.basic300}`,
        borderRadius: 4,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
    >
      <AppPage>
        <AppPageHeader>
          <Typography variant="body-emphasis" color={theme.textDefault}>
            {label}
          </Typography>
        </AppPageHeader>
        <AppPageMain>
          <AppPageAside width={asideWidth} data-qa="custom-aside">
            <Flex direction="column" gap={2}>
              {['Filter A', 'Filter B', 'Filter C'].map((f) => (
                <Box
                  key={f}
                  paddingX={3}
                  paddingY={2}
                  backgroundColor={theme.primarySurface}
                  style={{ borderRadius: 4 }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.primary600}>
                    {f}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </AppPageAside>
          <AppPageContent>
            <Box
              height="100%"
              backgroundColor={theme.basic100}
              style={{ borderRadius: 4 }}
            >
              <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.basic600}>
                Content area
              </Typography>
            </Box>
          </AppPageContent>
        </AppPageMain>
      </AppPage>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap={4}>
      <PageShell asideWidth={300} label="width={300} — fixed pixel width" />
      <PageShell asideWidth="30%" label='width="30%" — proportional width' />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Borderless Variant

Set `isBordered={false}` on `AppPageHeader` and `AppPageAside` to remove the separator lines. Use this when background color contrast already provides sufficient visual separation.

- Top: default `isBordered={true}` — separator lines visible
- Bottom: `isBordered={false}` on both Header and Aside — borderless

```tsx preview
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
  Typography,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

function Shell({ isBordered, label }: { isBordered: boolean; label: string }) {
  const theme = useTheme();
  return (
    <Box
      height={200}
      backgroundColor={isBordered ? theme.white : theme.basic100}
      style={{
        border: `1px solid ${theme.basic300}`,
        borderRadius: 4,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
    >
      <AppPage>
        <AppPageHeader isBordered={isBordered} paddingX={6} paddingY={3}>
          <Typography variant="body-emphasis" color={theme.textDefault}>
            {label}
          </Typography>
        </AppPageHeader>
        <AppPageMain>
          <AppPageAside isBordered={isBordered} width={180}>
            <Flex direction="column" gap={2}>
              {['Overview', 'Settings', 'Reports'].map((item) => (
                <Box
                  key={item}
                  paddingX={3}
                  paddingY={2}
                  style={{ borderRadius: 4, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.primary600}>
                    {item}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </AppPageAside>
          <AppPageContent>
            <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.basic600}>
              Main content area
            </Typography>
          </AppPageContent>
        </AppPageMain>
      </AppPage>
    </Box>
  );
}

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap={4}>
      <Shell
        isBordered={true}
        label="isBordered={true} — default, separator lines visible"
      />
      <Shell
        isBordered={false}
        label="isBordered={false} — borderless, background provides separation"
      />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Page-Wide Footer

Use `AppPageFooter` as a direct child of `AppPage`, placed after `AppPageMain`. The footer spans the full page width and stays pinned at the bottom regardless of scroll position. Content in `AppPageContent` continues to scroll independently above it.

```tsx preview
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageContent,
  AppPageFooter,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageContent,
  AppPageFooter,
  Typography,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';

export default function Demo() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const rows = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => `Row item ${i + 1}`);

  return (
    <Box
      height={400}
      style={{
        border: `1px solid ${theme.basic300}`,
        borderRadius: 4,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
    >
      <AppPage>
        <AppPageHeader>
          <Typography
            variant="card-title"
            asLevel={4}
            color={theme.textDefault}
          >
            Schedule Editor
          </Typography>
        </AppPageHeader>

        <AppPageMain>
          <AppPageContent>
            <Flex direction="column" gap={3}>
              {rows.map((row) => (
                <Box
                  key={row}
                  paddingX={4}
                  paddingY={3}
                  backgroundColor={theme.basic100}
                  style={{ borderRadius: 4 }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body" color={theme.textDefault}>
                    {row}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </AppPageContent>
        </AppPageMain>

        <AppPageFooter>
          <Flex gap={3} alignX="end">
            <Button type="secondary">Cancel</Button>
            <Button type="primary">Save Changes</Button>
          </Flex>
        </AppPageFooter>
      </AppPage>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Content-Area Footer

Pass `<AppPageFooter>` to the `footer` prop on `AppPageContent` to pin it inside the content column only. The footer does not span the full page width — the sidebar remains unaffected — and the content area above it continues to scroll independently.

```tsx preview
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
  AppPageFooter,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import { useTheme } from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-theme-provider';
import {
  AppPage,
  AppPageHeader,
  AppPageMain,
  AppPageAside,
  AppPageContent,
  AppPageFooter,
  Typography,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';
import Button from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-button';

export default function Demo() {
  const theme = useTheme();
  const rows = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => `Row item ${i + 1}`);
  const navItems = ['Overview', 'Agents', 'Queues', 'Reports'];

  return (
    <Box
      height={400}
      style={{
        border: `1px solid ${theme.basic300}`,
        borderRadius: 4,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      }}
    >
      <AppPage>
        <AppPageHeader>
          <Typography
            variant="card-title"
            asLevel={4}
            color={theme.textDefault}
          >
            Queue Configuration
          </Typography>
        </AppPageHeader>

        <AppPageMain>
          <AppPageAside width={180}>
            <Flex direction="column" gap={2}>
              {navItems.map((item) => (
                <Box
                  key={item}
                  paddingX={3}
                  paddingY={2}
                  backgroundColor={theme.primarySurface}
                  style={{ borderRadius: 4, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="caption" color={theme.primary600}>
                    {item}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </AppPageAside>

          <AppPageContent
            footer={
              <AppPageFooter>
                <Flex gap={3} alignX="end">
                  <Button type="secondary">Discard</Button>
                  <Button type="primary">Apply</Button>
                </Flex>
              </AppPageFooter>
            }
          >
            <Flex direction="column" gap={3}>
              {rows.map((row) => (
                <Box
                  key={row}
                  paddingX={4}
                  paddingY={3}
                  backgroundColor={theme.basic100}
                  style={{ borderRadius: 4 }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body" color={theme.textDefault}>
                    {row}
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              ))}
            </Flex>
          </AppPageContent>
        </AppPageMain>
      </AppPage>
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Props

### AppPage

| Prop             | Type        | Default        | Description                                                |
| ---------------- | ----------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `children`       | `ReactNode` | —              | `AppPageHeader` + `AppPageMain` + optional `AppPageFooter` |
| `data-qa`        | `string`    | —              | QA selector                                                |
| `data-component` | `string`    | `'WFMAppPage'` | Component identifier                                       |

### AppPageHeader

| Prop         | Type        | Default | Description                                   |
| ------------ | ----------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `children`   | `ReactNode` | —       | Header content                                |
| `isBordered` | `boolean`   | `true`  | Renders a 1 px bottom border below the header |
| `paddingX`   | `Space`     | `6`     | Horizontal padding token — `6` = 24 px        |
| `paddingY`   | `Space`     | `4`     | Vertical padding token — `4` = 16 px          |
| `data-qa`    | `string`    | —       | QA selector                                   |

### AppPageMain

| Prop       | Type        | Default | Description                            |
| ---------- | ----------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | —       | `AppPageAside` and/or `AppPageContent` |
| `data-qa`  | `string`    | —       | QA selector                            |

### AppPageAside

| Prop         | Type               | Default | Description                                     |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `children`   | `ReactNode`        | —       | Sidebar content — scrolls when it overflows     |
| `width`      | `string \| number` | `240`   | Panel width; accepts CSS values or pixel number |
| `isBordered` | `boolean`          | `true`  | Renders a 1 px right border beside the aside    |
| `paddingX`   | `Space`            | `4`     | Horizontal padding token — `4` = 16 px          |
| `paddingY`   | `Space`            | `4`     | Vertical padding token — `4` = 16 px            |
| `data-qa`    | `string`           | —       | QA selector                                     |

### AppPageContent

| Prop       | Type        | Default | Description                                                                        |
| ---------- | ----------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | —       | Main content — scrolls when it overflows                                           |
| `footer`   | `ReactNode` | —       | Pinned footer inside the content column — does not scroll. Pass `<AppPageFooter>`. |
| `paddingX` | `Space`     | `6`     | Horizontal padding token — `6` = 24 px                                             |
| `paddingY` | `Space`     | `4`     | Vertical padding token — `4` = 16 px                                               |
| `data-qa`  | `string`    | —       | QA selector                                                                        |

### AppPageFooter

| Prop         | Type        | Default | Description                                       |
| ------------ | ----------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `children`   | `ReactNode` | —       | Footer content — action bars, save/cancel buttons |
| `isBordered` | `boolean`   | `true`  | Renders a 1 px top border above the footer        |
| `paddingX`   | `Space`     | `6`     | Horizontal padding token — `6` = 24 px            |
| `paddingY`   | `Space`     | `4`     | Vertical padding token — `4` = 16 px              |
| `data-qa`    | `string`    | —       | QA selector                                       |

> `Space` tokens map to the 4 px grid: `1` = 4 px, `2` = 8 px, `3` = 12 px, `4` = 16 px, `6` = 24 px, `8` = 32 px.

## Layout Notes

- `AppPage` must have a **bounded height** set by its parent (e.g. `height: 100vh`, `height: 400px`). Without a fixed height the main area cannot constrain overflow.
- `min-height: 0` on `AppPageMain` and `min-width: 0` on `AppPageContent` are applied internally — required by the CSS flexbox spec to allow children to shrink below their intrinsic content size.
- `AppPageAside` is optional. When omitted, `AppPageContent` fills the full width of `AppPageMain`.
